name: poliscope
description: Poliscope — auditable controversy evidence mapping for computational social science, built on EpistemoBrain.

plugins.name: poliscope
plugins.description: Run auditable Poliscope research tasks: a seven-scientist council working over EpistemoBrain (a multi-agent generalization of MemoBrain's executive memory) produces a controversy evidence map with blindspots and preserved dissent instead of a single summarized answer. /poliscope turns a contested empirical question into a Research Contract, confirms atomic claims with the researcher, and streams the council's progress.
